sync.explain: Your notes are synced automatically via a hidden folder in your own Google Drive. Only PlaceLog can access it; your other files stay invisible to the app. Connect the same Google account on every device.

install.hint: Put PlaceLog on your home screen or in the Start menu. It then also works offline in its own window.

install.iosWarning: Note: Safari and the installed app keep their data separately. So install before you create notes.
